subtitle_id: Workbench Eksperimentasi & Optimasi Prompt untuk Pengembang LLM
subtitle_en: Developer Workbench for Prompt Engineering, Evaluation & Optimization
description_id: Aplikasi developer tool untuk merancang, menguji, dan membandingkan variasi prompt LLM sistematis. Membantu AI Engineer menguji ketahanan role-prompting, few-shot examples, token efficiency, dan edge-case refusal sebelum model dideploy ke produksi.
description_en: Developer workbench application designed to formulate, test, and benchmark LLM prompt variations. Enables AI Engineers to systematically validate system prompt guardrails, few-shot distributions, token usage, and edge-case behaviors before deployment.
architecture_id:
1. Fitur Utama Workbench

  • Side-by-side Comparison: Menguji dua variasi prompt secara paralel terhadap test input yang sama.
  • Token & Cost Counter: Estimasi konsumsi context window dan biaya per panggilan model.
  • Template Engine: Variabel dinamis untuk penyusunan prompt terstruktur.
architecture_en:
1. Workbench Capabilities

  • Side-by-side Comparison: Parallel comparison of prompt variants against uniform test inputs.
  • Token & Cost Estimation: Live context window calculation and token optimization metrics.
  • Template Engine: Dynamic variable injection for structured system prompt generation.

blueprint.function_id: Variasi System Prompt A & B + Variabel Template Dinamis + Test Input -> Eksekusi Paralel LLM API -> Komparasi Output Berdampingan + Kalkulasi Konsumsi Token & Estimasi Biaya.
blueprint.function_en: System Prompt Variants A & B + Dynamic Template Variables + Test Inputs -> Parallel LLM API Execution -> Side-by-Side Output Diffing + Token & Cost Profiling.
blueprint.utility_id: Menggantikan proses coba-coba prompt secara acak di chat biasa dengan pengujian A/B yang terstruktur dan terukur, menghemat waktu iterasi prompt engineering sekaligus memangkas pemborosan token.
blueprint.utility_en: Replaces ad-hoc prompt trial-and-error with structured side-by-side A/B testing, accelerating prompt engineering iterations while reducing unnecessary token usage.
blueprint.target_id: AI Engineer, LLM Application Developer, dan Prompt Engineer yang membangun fitur berbasis Google Gemini API / OpenAI SDK.
blueprint.target_en: AI Engineers, LLM Application Developers, and Prompt Engineers building production features on Google Gemini API or OpenAI-compatible SDKs.
layman_proof_id: Layar Uji Banding Berdampingan (A vs B): Pengguna langsung melihat bagaimana perubahan 1 kalimat instruksi mengubah kualitas dan kerapian jawaban AI pada layar kiri vs kanan.
Kalkulator Token & Biaya Otomatis: Menampilkan jumlah token secara langsung sehingga mudah memahami prompt mana yang lebih hemat biaya.
layman_proof_en: Side-by-Side A/B Comparison View: Immediately see how changing a single constraint alters response quality and structure across Variant A and Variant B.
Live Token & Cost Meter: Displays real-time token counts so anyone can verify which prompt achieves the goal with lower cost.

eval_metrics.optimized: Parallel A/B Variant Execution with Variable Injection
eval_metrics.secondary: Deterministic comparison on identical test inputs
